description: OpenClaw: Feishu webhook mode accepted forged events when only `verificationToken` was configured
how_introduced: This AI-coauthored commit replaced the Feishu implementation and first introduced webhook-oriented config fields (`connectionMode`, `webhookPath`, `webhookPort`) while leaving `encryptKey` optional in both `extensions/feishu/src/channel.ts` and `extensions/feishu/src/config-schema.ts`. It also created `createEventDispatcher()` with optional `encryptKey`/`verificationToken`, establishing the security model that the fix later reverses by requiring `encryptKey`. Although built-in webhook serving was not yet wired up in `monitor.ts`, the commit authored the latent flawed design, so the screening hypothesis was directionally correct.

bug_commits.author: Yifeng Wang
bug_commits.message: feat(feishu): replace built-in SDK with community plugin

agent_verdicts.reasoning: This AI-coauthored commit replaced the Feishu implementation and first introduced webhook-oriented config fields (`connectionMode`, `webhookPath`, `webhookPort`) while leaving `encryptKey` optional in both `extensions/feishu/src/channel.ts` and `extensions/feishu/src/config-schema.ts`. It also created `createEventDispatcher()` with optional `encryptKey`/`verificationToken`, establishing the security model that the fix later reverses by requiring `encryptKey`. Although built-in webhook serving was not yet wired up in `monitor.ts`, the commit authored the latent flawed design, so the screening hypothesis was directionally correct.

This AI-coauthored multi-account sync copied the same flaw into per-account configuration: it added account-level `encryptKey: z.string().optional()` / `encryptKey: { type: "string" }` and carried optional `encryptKey`/`verificationToken` into `ResolvedFeishuAccount` and `createEventDispatcher(account)`. The final fix tightens exactly these account-level definitions and checks. This commit did not create exploitability by itself, but it introduced the vulnerable design for multi-account Feishu webhook mode.

bug_commits.author: Yifeng Wang
bug_commits.message: feat(feishu): sync upstream changes from clawdbot-feishu

agent_verdicts.reasoning: This AI-coauthored commit is the exploit-enabling change: it removed the prior 'webhook mode not implemented' behavior and routed `connectionMode === "webhook"` into a real `monitorWebhook()` that starts an HTTP server and hands requests directly to `Lark.adaptDefault(path, eventDispatcher, { autoChallenge: true })`. Because the dispatcher still accepted missing `encryptKey` and there was no startup/schema enforcement yet, the previously latent optional-credential design became reachable and forged events could be accepted. Under the calling-context rule, this commit is a confirmed BIC.
